summary: This bill requires colleges and universities participating in federal student aid programs to promote awareness of Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 by displaying information about discrimination complaint procedures and an annual public awareness campaign, while also mandating monthly congressional briefings and an annual audit and study by the Department of Education's Inspector General regarding discrimination complaints.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses on higher education institutions, specifically requiring them to disseminate information about Title VI of the Civil Rights Act and report on discrimination complaints. While it doesn't directly address spending on public schools (K-12), it mandates actions for institutions receiving federal student aid, which are primarily colleges and universities. The bill's core is about civil rights enforcement and awareness within higher education, not public school funding.
